The candidate method is only a simple locale/style parser delegation that calls getFormatter(bucket.getLocale()).getParser().parseInto(...), and it is not shown in the stack or call-chain evidence. It does not initialize the parser bucket, preserve the existing year/time/zone, resolve February 29, or mutate the MutableDateTime. The observed failure is much more plausibly caused in DateTimeFormatter.parseInto or DateTimeParserBucket field/default-year/chronology handling, not this delegating DateTimeFormat method.

judge_ranking.defect_type: timezone-adjusted default year computed with zoned chronology
wrong default-year initialization in caller rather than computeMillis logic
